entrypoint: exec > /tmp/hy3-serve.log 2>&1; export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1; sed -i 's|"<think>"|"<think:opensource>"|g; s|"</think>"|"</think:opensource>"|g' /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/reasoning/hy_v3_reasoning_parser.py; sed -i 's|"<tool_calls>"|"<tool_calls:opensource>"|g; s|"</tool_calls>"|"</tool_calls:opensource>"|g; s|"<tool_call>"|"<tool_call:opensource>"|g; s|"</tool_call>"|"</tool_call:opensource>"|g; s|"<tool_sep>"|"<tool_sep:opensource>"|g; s|"<arg_key>"|"<arg_key:opensource>"|g; s|"</arg_key>"|"</arg_key:opensource>"|g; s|"<arg_value>"|"<arg_value:opensource>"|g; s|"</arg_value>"|"</arg_value:opensource>"|g' /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm/tool_parsers/hy_v3_tool_parser.py; exec vllm serve ...

measured.concurrency_notes: No tok/s numbers in repo. KV pool ~287k tokens (fp8_e4m3, GMU 0.90): ~2.19x concurrency at 131072; 1 request at 262144.

extra_setup: sudo systemctl stop earlyoom on the head before every start (or move vllm/ray/python to --avoid in /etc/default/earlyoom). Head: python3 + huggingface_hub, downloads via snapshot_download and rsyncs the hub dir to the worker; image is docker save | ssh docker load to the worker. Containers run 'ray start ... --num-gpus=1 --object-store-memory=134217728 --disable-usage-stats --block' (head --head --port=26480, worker --address=10.0.0.1:26480); vLLM is launched with docker exec -d in hy3-head running /serve-tools-hy3.sh. Passwordless SSH head->worker.
notes: Container entrypoint is the Ray process; the vLLM server runs via docker exec (entrypoint above describes that serve script, which seds the hy_v3 reasoning/tool parsers to the ':opensource' token forms). ${MODEL_REVISION} is the snapshot hash snapshot_download resolves (not pinned). VLLM_HOST_IP head 10.0.0.1, worker 10.0.0.2. CLUSTER_IFACE must be the NIC with the 10.0.0.x IPs, not the RoCE NIC. Thinking needs chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort low|high (default no_think).
